scenario: LUNI.11.2 — there is no `U`: `u` is the unit label alone, and a value with its label is written `{r.temp} {r.temp:u}`. `{r.temp:U}` on a unit-typed slot therefore fails [LGRA.2.9.6.1]'s grammar and the compiler refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_FORMAT, in `dsc.validate.luni_11_2_format` from `dsc.strlit.lgra_2_9_6_1_format`'s reading.
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Reading scope logical:
    temp: celsius key

rule warm:
    Reading r where r.temp > 30_celsius
->
    log info "temp = {r.temp:U}"
